description: This file defines an abstract class 'NotesServerSyncTask' responsible for synchronizing notes between a local repository and a remote server in an Android application. It includes methods for pushing local changes and pulling remote updates, handling network exceptions, and managing synchronization callbacks.

classes.name: NotesServerSyncTask
classes.description: An abstract class extending Thread that manages synchronization of notes between local storage and a remote server, including methods for pushing local changes and pulling remote updates.

methods.name: addCallbacks
methods.description: Adds synchronization callbacks for a specific account.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Overrides Thread.run() to perform pre-execution setup, initiate synchronization, and handle post-execution.

methods.name: onPreExecute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for setup before synchronization begins.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for handling results after synchronization completes.

methods.name: pushLocalChanges
methods.description: Pushes local note modifications to the remote server, handling creation, editing, and deletion.

methods.name: pullRemoteChanges
methods.description: Fetches remote note updates and deletions, updating local storage accordingly.
